description: 3D perf budget (Sprint 8). Compared on the steady per-frame draw-call count (callsSteady = min over frames); callsMax (a frame where the shadow map is refreshed) is kept for information. target = S8 goal (informational until reached); baseline = last accepted measurement, guarded with regressionTolerance. Counts only — FPS is not measured headless.
toleranceNote: 8%: first-person steady draw calls vary ~4% between runs (wandering agents enter/leave the view), measured 612-637.
